title: The Squirrel and the First Snow

chapters.title: The Squirrel and the First Snow

pages.text: All through the golden autumn, Squirrel gathered acorns. "Come play!" called the chipmunks, leaping in the leaves.
"Soon!" said Squirrel, tucking acorns into the old oak. "First I fill my little pantry. Then I can play with my whole heart."
"But the sun is out!" laughed the chipmunks. "Snow is far, far away!" "That's the best time to get ready," said Squirrel. "When it's easy."
And when his pantry was full — oh, how he played! He leapt the longest leaps and rolled the rolliest rolls, and not one single worry followed him through the leaves.
Then one morning, the world woke up white. Snow on the branches. Snow on the meadow. Snow on the chipmunks' empty cheeks.
Squirrel opened his warm little pantry, full to the very top. "Breakfast?" he said. And of course he shared — because a full pantry is even better with friends inside it.
"When did you find time to get ready?" asked the smallest chipmunk, munching. Squirrel smiled. "Before I needed to."
Getting ready when it's easy makes you ready when it's not.
Y colorín colorado, este cuento se ha acabado.
